refinement_definition.target_loaded_shape: current VSP / structural cruise geometry on main and rear spar beam nodes
refinement_definition.refresh_method: candidate-level AVL geometry + strip-force AoA sweep for the baseline load owner; later refresh steps interpolate within the candidate-owned AVL AoA sweep
physics_assumptions: Each stage is still a one-way structural solve on the existing beam-line target shape.
The beam-line target shape remains fixed across refresh iterations.
The initial baseline loads come from a candidate-owned AVL geometry and strip-force AoA sweep.
Later refresh steps reuse that candidate-owned AVL AoA sweep; AVL is not rerun after each structural update.
Structural twist is treated as local washout with a simple scalar scale factor.
The forward refresh check estimates frozen-load bias by applying refreshed displacement to the previous jig.
difference_from_full_coupling: capped outer refresh count instead of iterating to convergence
baseline candidate lift shape is rebuilt once from AVL strip forces while torque stays on the legacy-selected state, but there is still no per-refresh AVL rerun
no trim solve or dynamic design-space update

aero_contract.load_ownership: legacy_refresh still owns the structural selected load-state; candidate_avl_spanwise only swaps in a candidate-owned AVL spanwise lift distribution shape for that already-selected state.
aero_contract.artifact_ownership: Candidate-owned AVL geometry, trim, strip-force, and spanwise-load artifacts live under /Volumes/Samsung SSD/hpa-mdo/output/pipeline_redesign_v2/tier2_loaded_shape_airfoil_mvp/runs/conservative_best/avl_run.
notes: Pipeline v2 MVP5 closure artifact from MVP4 selected-airfoil AVL rerun.
Structure response remains daily-screening/report-only.
Structural selected state is re-aligned to the old legacy_refresh owner by reusing the shared cfg.io VSPAero sweep selection rule.
Selected cruise AoA source: mvp4_selected_airfoil_avl_trim.
candidate_avl_spanwise now replaces only the spanwise lift distribution shape; drag / torque ownership stay on the legacy-selected structural state.

AVL lift shape for the selected structural state comes from the closest candidate-owned strip-force case by half-span lift (shape AoA 0.122 deg), then it is rescaled back to the legacy-selected total lift.
Outer-loop gate owner metadata: mvp4_selected_airfoil_loaded_shape_avl_rerun.
Boundary coverage: nearest_strip_coefficients_with_avl_root_tip_chord.
